title: THE SEALED EXPRESS
premise: On an interwar luxury night train, a famous jewel is discovered to be a replica after a tunnel blackout even though its locked display was never opened during the journey.

facts.text: The display seals remained intact throughout the journey.
The jewel inside the display after the tunnel is a replica.
A pre-departure image already shows the replica rather than the authenticated original.
The substitution did not occur during the tunnel blackout.
GAMMA violated a train procedure during the journey.
ALPHA had custody-level access before the display was sealed for departure.
ALPHA demonstrates unusually precise knowledge of a distinctive feature of the authenticated original.
ALPHA replaced the real jewel before departure.
The tunnel alarm created a memorable time boundary but did not prove access to the jewel.

actions.label: Challenge ALPHA about his knowledge of the original jewel.

completion_conditions.description: Prove the tunnel was a false crime window and correctly accuse ALPHA.
